blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Joanie Delgaco finished sixth in the women’s single sculls final at the 2026 Asian Games on Thursday, ending her campaign without a medal but already looking ahead to her next chance at Olympic qualification. Delgaco clocked 8 minutes, 1.63 seconds in Final A at Nagaragawa International Regatta Course. China’s Zhang Xinyu won the gold in 7:21.53, with Uzbekistan’s Anna Prakaten taking silver and Iran’s Fatemeh Mojallal Topraghhale claiming bronze.
